questions.question_text: Bhagwānno bhakta hoy athavā koī bījo hoy, paṇ garībmātrane __________ nahī. Ane jo garībne dukhve to tenu koī prakāre sāru thāy nahī ane jo garībne dukhve to brahmahatyā jeṭlu pāp thāy chhe.
questions.explanation: Vachanamrut Ga.Pr. 72 spashṭa kahe chhe ke garībmātrane leshmātra dukhvavo nahī.

questions.question_text: Vach.Ga.Pr.72 mujab, jo garībne dukhve to keṭlu pāp thāy chhe?
questions.explanation: Vachanamrut Ga.Pr. 72 mā lakhyu chhe ke jo garībne dukhve to brahmahatyā jeṭlu pāp thāy chhe.

questions.question_text: Vach.Ga.Pr.72 pramāṇe, Bhagwānno bhakta hoy athavā koī bījo hoy, paṇ garībne leshmātra dukhve to tenum shaṁuṁ thāy nahī?
options: tenu koī prakāre sāru thāy nahī
questions.correct_answer: tenu koī prakāre sāru thāy nahī
questions.explanation: Vachanamrut Ga.Pr. 72 anusār, jo garībne dukhve to tenu koī prakāre sāru thāy nahī.

questions.question_text: Jo dharma, arth ne kām sambandhī je ___________ teno tyāg karīne tenā te shubh karma jo Bhagwānnī prasannatāne arthe kare to e ja shubh karma chhe te bhaktirūp thaīne kevaḷ mokshane arthe thāy chhe.
questions.explanation: Vachanamrut Ga.Ma. 11 kahe chhe ke dharma, arth ne kām sambandhī je phaḷnī icchā teno tyāg karvo.

questions.question_text: Vach.Ga.Ma.11 pramāṇe, shubh karma kyāre bhaktirūp thaīne kevaḷ mokshane arthe thāy chhe?
options: dharma, arth ne kāmne arthe kare to
questions.explanation: Vachanamrut Ga.Ma. 11 anusār, shubh karma jo Bhagwānnī prasannatāne arthe kare to te bhaktirūp thaīne kevaḷ mokshane arthe thāy chhe.

questions.question_text: Jo dharma, arth ne kām sambandhī je phaḷnī icchā teno tyāg karīne tenā te shubh karma jo Bhagwānnī prasannatāne arthe kare to e ja shubh karma chhe te ___________ thaīne kevaḷ mokshane arthe thāy chhe.
questions.explanation: Vachanamrut Ga.Ma. 11 spashṭa kahe chhe ke te shubh karma bhaktirūp thaīne kevaḷ mokshane arthe thāy chhe.

questions.question_text: Vach.Ga.Pr.72 mujab, garībmātrane leshmātra dukhvavo nahī — ā vachan koṇane lāgu paḍe chhe?
options: Bhagwānno bhakta hoy athavā koī bījo hoy
questions.correct_answer: Bhagwānno bhakta hoy athavā koī bījo hoy
questions.explanation: Vachanamrut Ga.Pr. 72 mā lakhyu chhe ke Bhagwānno bhakta hoy athavā koī bījo hoy, paṇ garībmātrane leshmātra dukhvavo nahī.

questions.question_text: Vach.Ga.Ma.11 pramāṇe, shubh karma ne bhaktirūp banāvavā māṭe kyā sambandhī phaḷnī icchāno tyāg karavānu kahyu chhe?
questions.explanation: Vachanamrut Ga.Ma. 11 mā dharma, arth ne kām sambandhī je phaḷnī icchā teno tyāg karavānu kahyu chhe.

questions.question_text: Vach.Ga.Ma.11 mujab, jo phaḷnī icchāno tyāg karīne shubh karma Bhagwānnī prasannatāne arthe kare to te kevaḷ shaṁuṁne arthe thāy chhe?
questions.explanation: Vachanamrut Ga.Ma. 11 anusār, te bhaktirūp thaīne kevaḷ mokshane arthe thāy chhe.

questions.question_text: Vach.Ga.Pr.72 mujab, jo garībne dukhve to tenu koī prakāre shuṁ thāy nahī?
questions.explanation: Vachanamrut Ga.Pr. 72 mā spashṭa chhe ke garībne dukhvavāthī tenu koī prakāre sāru thāy nahī.
